results.title: Clever Steam Machine mod turns the faceplate into something useful
results.description: The Steam Machine's interchangeable front panel was designed to let users easily customize the look of their console. A Reddit user has now shown that a faceplate can be more than just cosmetic – by turning it into a mount and charging dock for the Steam Controller.
